metadata.description: Review the actual diff of a change, branch, or pull request for defects - correctness bugs, regressions, scope mistakes, missing behavior, and security issues where relevant - and report prioritized findings, or say plainly that none were found. Use when the user asks to review, critique, or look over code changes, a diff, a commit, a branch, or a PR, typically before merging. Not for explaining unfamiliar code, writing new features, proving by running it that a specific behavior works (verifying-changes), judging a story against its acceptance criteria (reviewing-story), or a dedicated security review or audit (reviewing-security).
